study type: Secondary analysis of prospectively collected data
exposure: Transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) scoring system for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) severity (components: uterine wall defect, arterial vascularity at uterine wall defect, cervical involvement)
cohort: The study included 73 patients from a quaternary center with suspected placenta accreta spectrum based on 2D ultrasound and clinical suspicion.
finding: The novel transvaginal ultrasound scoring system effectively stratified patients into categories of low versus higher risk for severe placenta accreta spectrum and associated intraoperative blood loss.
